decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed hotel accommodation would not be well located in terms of the Town Centre and is not well served by existing public transport facilities.  It is therefore considered to be in an inappropriate and unsustainable location and would also be likely to attract unacceptable numbers of car borne visitors particularly at unsociable hours resulting in noise and disturbance to adjoining residents contrary to UDP policies ENV-B.1.1, E.5.1 and T.1.4.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development by reason of its size, design and massing would appear over-dominant to adjoining residential properties resulting in loss of light and amenity contrary to UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 and E.5.1.

Condition : 3 - The proposed hotel accommodation and associated facilities would result in increased activity on the site to the detriment of the amenity of adjoining residents contrary to UDP policies ENV.1.1, C and H.2.1.

Condition : 4 - The proposed car and coach parking provision is inadequate, the site is poorly served by public transport, on-street parking is already congested and any overflow from the proposed hotel could not be tolerated by the public highway. The proposal would be likely to result in additional kerbside parking, which would detract from conditions of safety and convenience on the public highway contrary to policy Policies E.5.1 and T.1.4. of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance11 (Roads, footpaths parking & servicing).

Condition : 5 - The proposal represents an over-development of a restricted site providing inadequate private amenity space, unacceptable levels of noise exposure and resulting in a poor quality residential environment for future residents of the site and neighbouring residential properties contrary to policies: H4.1 and H4.2 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance 1 Design & Layout, 9 Form & Design and 10 Private Amenity Space.

Condition : 6 - The layout, bulk and massing of the proposed buildings would be out of character with surrounding development and would represent an ungainly and overbearing development, which would be detrimental to the character of the area and the outlook from neighbouring residential properties contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1. of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance 1 (Design & Layout) and 9 (Form & Design).
Condition : 7 - The proposal makes inadequate provision of affordable housing contrary to policies H.2.1 and H.3.5 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 8 - The proposed layout is deficient for vehicles and pedestrians accessing the site and would lead to an intensification of a sub-standard access, which could affect the efficiency of the bus and highway network and have a detrimental impact on the safety of users of the TLRN, including vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists contrary to policies T2.1, T2.2, T4.3 & T4.4 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 9 - The application has failed to demonstrate that the access, parking and turning arrangements are adequate to safely serve the proposed development and therefore, if permitted, could lead to hazardous manoeuvres, including vehicles reversing onto the public highway, to the detriment of the TLRN contrary to policies T2.1, T2.2, T4.3 & T4.4 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Demolition of existing buildings and erection of 147 bedroomed hotel and 139 residential units (Outline application for siting and access)
